anomalies.detail: Prod-main success fell to 81.0% (from 92.4/92.5/94.5 on 06-24/23/22) — worst since ~06-18. UNLIKE 06-20 (Skillet) this is NOT one workflow: 32 of 40 prod-main fails are 0-tok/0-turn agent-job failures distributed across ~16 distinct wfs and 4 engines (copilot15/pi7/claude6/codex2/null2). Spread evenly across the 24h window AND across gh-aw versions 0.80.2/1.0.65/2.1.191 — so NOT a single transient incident nor single-version regression. Reads as an aggregation of many independent agent-startup failures sharing a generic signature, plus 3 genuinely-new per-wf hotspots. Could be a noisy day OR an early systemic agent-startup degradation. CRITICAL to compare 06-26: revert-to-baseline => transient; persists => systemic.

Auto-Triage Issues (pi engine, model copilot/gpt-5.4 experimental) 5/6 fail. 0-tok/0-turn agent:failure ~2-6min, surrounding jobs green. Top single-wf prod-main offender this window. NEW. Likely experimental pi/gpt-5.4 driver or model-availability issue.

Avenger 10/10 fail this 24h window (claude, model='agent', Turns=0, ~14-19m). Accounts for 38% of all prod-main fails. Removing Avenger lifts prod-main from 86.3% to 91.2%. | 06-30: 4/4 fail in 10.5h window (rate consistent ~every 90min). MODEL CHANGED to claude-haiku-4.5 (was 'agent'/sonnet) — swap did NOT fix err-config. Still fails at 'Parse agent logs for step summary'.

Smoke CI 11/11=100% fail on push to main (copilot/claude-sonnet-4.6, 0-turn 4-5m, fails at 'Execute GitHub Copilot CLI'). High-frequency push-triggered wf = constant red on main. Largest single-cause contributor to the 65.9% prod-main rate this window (removing it lifts prod-main to 75.7%). Likely real copilot CLI/engine startup regression on main, not noise. 06-28/29 unobserved so onset may be earlier.

copilot 'Execute GitHub Copilot CLI' 0-turn/0-tok failures = 25/32 (78%) of ALL fleet fails on 2026-06-30. Spans Smoke CI(11,100%), PR Sous Chef(9,82%), Safe Output Integrator(25m), Blog Writer(19m), PR Code Quality Reviewer(2x,20m,PR), Issues Report Gen(10m). Two variants: instant 4-5m (Smoke CI) and longrun 19-25m (Safe Output Integrator/Blog Writer/PR CQR).
